description: Finishes the welcome steps of a paid product, as the dashboard of the First app does. It saves the acceptance of the statements of welcome.confirm from get_started, and the optional phone. Call it only at the onboarding stage. First show each statement, and get an explicit yes to each one from the customer. Then invite the partner with invite_partner when the next step of get_started asks for it. Returns the next setup step, as get_started does.

accept_terms.description: True only after the customer said yes to the statement about the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy.

acknowledge_signing.description: The prenup and the postnup only. True only after the customer said yes to the statement about the signature.

phone.description: The customer's US phone number, for texts about the service.

product.description: The product line of the welcome steps.

skip_phone.description: True when the customer declines to give a phone. The app then does not ask again. Leave out phone and skip_phone when you did not ask.

name: finish_welcome_steps
title: Finish the welcome steps
